The flag sits under the name in the first column; Invoice, Jobs, Date and Total keep their room at every size.

svg.text: Header, switch and table follow Draws: PageHeader with New invoice (primary, Plus), SegmentedControl md, Table with RowCell rows.
Paid shows no count (needs Connor's OK): once Paid passes 99, a third count pushes the switch past 288px at 320.
At 320 (Geist, touch sizes) the switch is about 260px and the title with New invoice about 265px of 288, so nothing wraps.
Phone (below 640): two lines a row. Invoice, Jobs and Date fold into the second line; Total keeps its own column.
On a phone the flag leads the second line, as a contractor's status does on Contractors; the job truncates first.
Over the cap: one Notice under the switch, To review only. The phone's shorter line holds one line at 320 up to 9 emails.
No contractor yet: the sender's address shows in --muted-foreground where the name goes (needs Connor's call).
To pay can show Possible duplicate too: a partner's own entry lands there straight away (M6). Who's this from? can't (M5).
To review and To pay sort oldest first so nothing sits; Paid sorts newest first (spec).
The whole row opens the invoice. No hover-only controls, so touch loses nothing.
Option B on a tablet drops Date to fit Flags; at 1280 it squeezes Jobs to about 370px.
At 1920 the list stops at 1600 wide, anchored to the rail, as every list does.
References: Shopify Bill Pay (Enter missing details under the vendor), Brex and Rocket Money phone lists (name over detail, amount right).
